name: microcosm
description: A sandbox for artificial organisms: a conserved-matter ecosystem simulator with an observatory that narrates what it sees.
//engines: Pinned deliberately, not conservatively (docs/android-port-plan.md M0). The certified fingerprints were captured on V8 12.4; Node >= 23 silently switches Math.pow to the host libm, and 2026 V8 moved sin/cos/exp/atan2 to LLVM-libc's correctly-rounded routines. A newer engine is a DIFFERENT oracle, not a better one. Probe: on an fdlibm-era V8, Math.pow(10,-5) !== 1e-5.

scripts.//acceptance: The ecology instruments and gates below drive the CRATE (rust/wasm/core.js), which is the simulation since the M4 handover (CLAUDE.md rule 11; decided for the acceptance authority on 2026-09-05). The frozen JavaScript oracle is still reachable for a re-measurement by calling the harness directly: `node harness/tune2.js` with MC_CORE unset.
scripts.tune: npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/tune2.js
scripts.gate: npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/k6gate.js
scripts.yoshida: npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/yoshida.js
scripts.corridor: npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/corridor.js
scripts.corridor:full: npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/corridor.js --rails --fuzz --sample 16
scripts.gate5: npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/gate5.js
scripts.light: npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/light.js --patches --seed
scripts.light:gate: npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/light.js --gate
scripts.heat:gate: npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/heat.js --gate
scripts.move: npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/move.js --metrics
scripts.move:trap: npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/move.js --trap
scripts.walls: npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/walls.js
scripts.levels: npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/levels.js
scripts.starts:check: MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/starts.js --check && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/starts.js --empty
scripts.walls:all: npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/walls.js --open --seal --hideout --shade
scripts.port:fingerprint: npm run build && node harness/fingerprint-raw.js 3000 && node harness/fingerprint-events.js
scripts.levels:nulls: npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/nulls.js
scripts.test:port: npm run wasm && npm run conform:core && npm run port:check && npm run port:snapshot && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/k6gate.js && npm run port:levels && npm run starts:check
scripts.yoshida:capture: npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/yoshida.js --capture
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run syntax && node harness/selftest.js && node harness/conform.js && node harness/prose.js && node harness/render-smoke.js && node harness/prose-app.js
scripts.test:full: npm run test && npm run wasm && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/tune2.js && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/k6gate.js && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/gate5.js && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/corridor.js --rails --fuzz && MC_CORE=$PWD/rust/wasm/core.js node harness/levels.js
